notes.title: FPS optimization
notes.notes:
I have made by your requests:

+ Plus 10 FPS (Light optimization)
+ Plus 10 FPS (if you off in the settings menu: Reflection probes, Nature and FX)
+ Light in the all rooms can be manipulated in real time. The more lighting is off, the more FPS.

I have 220 FPS when:
Turn off full screen
Turn screen size to 1920x1080
Turn off Reflection probes, Nature and FX
Turn off light in all rooms.

Now game loading is not in full screen mode by default, with 1920x1080 resolution.

notes.title: Photo camera mode with zooming and filters
notes.notes:
I have made by your requests:

+ Improved "Esc" menu
+ Quality settings ("Esc" menu) Very low mode for potato PC
+ Cross-hair has been removed from photos

"LeftShift" + "p" - Photo camera mode on/off (non-vr)
"Mouse wheel" (When you are in the photo camera mode) - zooming in/out
"v" (When you are in the photo camera mode) - switch between camera filters

notes.title: Now you can make photos and record videos
notes.notes:
I have made by your requests:

+ "Esc menu" increased
+ Info about hot keys in the "Esc menu"
+ Possibility to record videos "F1" start, "F2" stop
+ Possibility to make photos "P"
+ Additional cameras rendering is a huge FPS killer. Because of it, by default monitor for Photo camera is off. You can make photos without monitor. But if you have top hardware, you can turn it on.

notes.title: Plan
notes.notes:
Photo studio game was released as early access game. 
A lot will be added in the near future. If you know me by my previous game "3D visual novel maker", you know how hard I work and how huge amount of content I am able to add.

Main plan is to add more animations. Creating animations by hands is very difficult process. So, I made decision to invest money to body motion capture hardware. So, I can record really nice animations.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LKdnhOU1umY

I hope that you like my game and that you will support me in its development.
